name: Modern Wave
tagline: Black-and-white modern deck with thick organic wave bands, bold rounded headings, and minimal type blocks.

palette.description: Pure white base, black organic wave bands, and occasional small outlined navigation glyphs.

typography.style: Heavy rounded black display type with plain sans body text.

best_for: Simple modern keynotes, introductions, creative overviews, quotes, and lightweight visual storytelling.
avoid_for: Dense analytics, formal proposals, or multi-table operational decks.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Modern Wave
source_inspiration.notes: Source-inspired HTML/CSS template rebuilt from public visual reference only; not a pixel copy and does not reuse source assets.
